title: Cold rebuild: the topic matcher
summary: Rebuild the topic-exchange matcher from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **A topic-exchange matcher** in *Topic, headers and unroutable messages*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Which routing keys does the binding `*.eu.#` match? Select all that apply.
steps.explain: `*` takes exactly one word before `eu`, and `#` may take none. `eu.created` has no word before `eu`, and `order.b2b` is two words.

steps.title: Rebuild the topic matcher cold
prompt: Write `bool TopicMatches(string pattern, string routingKey)` with RabbitMQ's topic rules:
- any other word must be equal (case-sensitive).
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
